# Third-party dependency licenses

These files reproduce the upstream licenses for the Go dependencies pinned in
`go.mod`. Keep this directory, the project `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`, and the Goss
license (`internal/goss/assets/LICENSE.goss`) with binary distributions.

Goss binaries come from the official v0.4.9 release. No third-party source code
is modified or vendored here.

`frontend.LICENSE` is generated by `web/scripts/licenses.mjs` during the frontend
build. It includes the full licenses for the actual production dependencies and
Tailwind's generated stylesheet; the build rejects a bundled dependency whose
declared license is outside MIT / ISC / Apache-2.0 / BSD.
